name: timesheet-grid
title: Timesheet grid
description: A weekly timesheet: projects down, days across, hours in each cell, with row and day totals, a daily target and week navigation.
docs: Pass projects ({ id, name, client }) and entries as entries[projectId]["2026-10-26"] = 7.5, with onChange(entries, change) to keep them; weekStart with onWeekChange, or defaultWeekStart, sets the week. A cell reads 7.5, 7:30, 7h 30m or 90m. Enter saves and moves down, the arrow keys move between cells, Escape undoes, and what cannot be read is said in words and kept to fix: every cell that was refused stays marked until it is edited, saved or undone. Row totals sit at the end and day totals in the footer; with dailyTarget and dailyCap a day says Target met, how much is short or to go, or that it is over the cap, always in words. Today's column says Today (pass now for the same output on the server and in the browser). locked makes every cell read-only and shows lockedReason. format switches between 7.5 and 7:30. On a phone the week scrolls sideways beside the pinned project names, a soft shade at the right edge says there is more, and the hint speaks of touch. labels translates every word.
